subject: Maths
name: Addition with Grouping
about: Your child learns to add 2-digit and 3-digit numbers when the ones or tens add up to 10 or more, carrying the extra ten or hundred to the next place. They practise with column sums and everyday word problems.

subject: Maths
name: Ascending and Descending Order
about: Your child learns to put numbers in ascending order (smallest to biggest) and descending order (biggest to smallest) by comparing hundreds, tens and ones. They also find the biggest and smallest numbers and make numbers from given digits.

subject: Maths
name: Calendar
about: Your child learns the days of the week and months of the year in order, how many days each month has, and how to read dates on a calendar. They also change weeks into days and solve simple date problems.

subject: Maths
name: Comparing Numbers
about: Your child learns to compare 2-digit and 3-digit numbers using the greater than (>), less than (<) and equal to (=) signs by looking at hundreds, tens and ones. They also find the greatest and smallest numbers in a group.

subject: Maths
name: Division
about: Your child learns that division means sharing equally or making equal groups, using repeated subtraction, the number line and times tables. They also find remainders and use long division for 2-digit numbers.

subject: Maths
name: Even and Odd Numbers
about: Your child learns that even numbers can be put into pairs and end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8, while odd numbers have one left over and end in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9. They also count in twos and spot even and odd numbers up to 999.

subject: Maths
name: Expanded Form
about: Your child learns to break a number into the value of each digit, such as 245 = 200 + 40 + 5, and to build a number back from its parts. They also work with zeros, place value and number names.

subject: Maths
name: Fractions
about: Your child learns that a fraction is an equal part of a whole, and practises halves, quarters and three quarters of shapes and of small groups of things.

subject: Maths
name: Measurement
about: Your child learns to measure length in cm and m, weight in g and kg, and capacity in mL and L, choosing the right unit and solving simple measuring problems.

subject: Maths
name: Money
about: Your child learns to recognise Indian coins and notes, add up amounts in rupees, work out change and understand that ₹1 is 100 paise.

subject: Maths
name: Multiplication
about: Your child learns that multiplication is quick adding of equal groups, using groups and arrays, and starts multiplying 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers.

subject: Maths
name: Multiplication Tables 1 to 10
about: Your child practises the times tables from 1 to 10, finds missing numbers in table facts and uses the tables to solve everyday problems.

subject: Maths
name: Number Names
about: Your child learns to read and write numbers up to 999 in words, spell tricky number names like forty and ninety correctly, and change words back into figures.

subject: Maths
name: Number Patterns
about: Your child learns to skip count in 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 10s and 100s, forwards and backwards, find missing numbers and spot the rule in a number pattern.

subject: Maths
name: Numbers up to 1000
about: Your child counts in hundreds up to 1000, reads and writes 3-digit numbers in figures and words, and finds numbers before, after and between. They also count on and back in tens and hundreds and compare and order numbers.

subject: Maths
name: Patterns and Symmetry
about: Your child spots and continues repeating patterns of colours, shapes and numbers, and finds the rule in number patterns. They also learn about symmetry: shapes and letters that have two matching halves.

subject: Maths
name: Place Value
about: Your child learns that each digit in a 3-digit number has a place (hundreds, tens or ones) and a value. They build numbers from blocks and money, split numbers into hundreds, tens and ones, and see how the number changes when 1, 10 or 100 is added.

subject: Maths
name: Shapes
about: Your child names flat (2D) shapes and solid (3D) shapes and finds them in everyday things. They count sides and corners, and the flat faces, edges and corners of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones and spheres.

subject: Maths
name: Subtraction with Borrowing
about: Your child learns to subtract 2- and 3-digit numbers when a digit on top is too small, by borrowing 1 ten (or 1 hundred) from the next place. They also borrow across zeros, check answers by adding, and solve everyday word problems with money and counting.

subject: Maths
name: Tally Marks
about: Your child learns to count with tally marks, bundling every fifth mark as a gate of five. They read and make tally charts and use them to answer questions such as which is most, which is least and how many more.

subject: Maths
name: Telling Time
about: Your child reads the time to the hour and half hour, knows the jobs of the hour and minute hands, and writes times in words and the digital way. They also work out simple times one hour or half an hour later.

subject: Maths
name: Word Problems
about: Your child reads short story sums and decides whether to add, subtract or multiply, using clue words like in all, left and each. They write the number sentence, solve it and try some two-step problems.

subject: English
name: Adjectives
about: Your child learns that adjectives are describing words that tell us about colour, size, shape, number, feel, sound and taste, and practises using them in sentences, including er and est to compare.

subject: English
name: Alphabetical Order
about: Your child learns the order of the letters a to z and uses it to put words and names in ABC order, first by the first letter and then by the second letter when the first letters match.

subject: English
name: Articles
about: Your child learns when to use the articles a, an and the: a before consonant sounds, an before vowel sounds, and the for a particular or one-of-a-kind thing.

subject: English
name: Common and Proper Nouns
about: Your child learns the difference between common nouns (general names like city or boy) and proper nouns (special names like Mumbai or Kunal), and that proper nouns always begin with a capital letter.

subject: English
name: Conjunctions
about: Your child learns to use the joining words and, but and or: and to add ideas, but to show a difference, and or to show a choice, and practises joining two short sentences into one.

subject: English
name: Making Sentences
about: Your child learns that a sentence is a group of words that makes complete sense, starting with a capital letter and ending with a full stop or question mark, and practises ordering jumbled words and writing telling and asking sentences.

subject: English
name: Nouns
about: Your child learns that nouns are naming words for people, places, animals and things, finds them in sentences, and begins to change nouns from one to many by adding s or es.

subject: English
name: Opposite Words
about: Your child learns opposite words, such as hot and cold or up and down, uses them in sentences, and makes opposites by adding un, as in happy and unhappy.

subject: English
name: Past, Present and Future Tense
about: Your child learns to tell whether something happened in the past, is happening now, or will happen in the future, and to change verbs to match, using will for the future.

subject: English
name: Prepositions
about: Your child learns place words such as in, on, under, behind, between and near, and uses them to say exactly where things are.

subject: English
name: Present Tense and Past Tense
about: Your child learns to tell what happens now or every day (present tense) from what already happened (past tense). They practise adding s, es, ed and d, the special past words like went and ate, was and were, and how to use did not and Did in questions.

subject: English
name: Pronouns
about: Your child learns to use he, she, it, we, they and I in place of names, so sentences do not repeat the same noun over and over.

subject: English
name: Punctuation
about: Your child learns to start sentences with a capital letter and end them with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark, and to use commas in a list.

subject: English
name: Reading Comprehension
about: Your child reads short passages and answers who, what, where and when questions, finding the answers in the text and writing them in full sentences.

subject: English
name: Rhyming Words
about: Your child learns to hear and find words that sound the same at the end, such as cat and bat, and uses them to make up simple rhymes.

subject: English
name: Singular and Plural
about: Your child learns to change one into many by adding s, es or ies, and learns special plurals such as child and children, and foot and feet.

subject: English
name: Synonyms
about: Your child learns that some words mean the same or almost the same, such as big and large or happy and glad, and uses them to make writing more interesting.

subject: English
name: Verbs
about: Your child learns to spot action words, use the right form with he, she and they, and add ing to show what someone is doing.

subject: Science
name: Air Around Us
about: Your child learns that air is all around us even though we cannot see it, that moving air is wind, and how wind helps us fly kites, dry clothes and turn windmills. They also learn that air takes up space and why we must keep it clean.

subject: Science
name: Animal Homes
about: Your child learns where different animals live, from dens, burrows and nests in the wild to sheds, stables and kennels that people build. They also learn why animals need a home and which animals live on land, in water or in trees.

subject: Science
name: Animal Sounds
about: Your child learns the names of the sounds animals make, such as barks, moos, roars, hoots and quacks, using them in sentences. They also learn that animals use sounds to call their babies, warn of danger and talk to each other.

subject: Science
name: Animals Around Us
about: Your child learns to tell pet, domestic (farm) and wild animals apart, what we get from farm animals and the work they do for us. They also learn the names of baby animals and how to behave around wild animals.

subject: Science
name: Birds
blurb: Parts of a Bird, Nests and Eggs
about: Your child learns the parts of a bird and what each part does, how birds build nests, lay eggs and hatch chicks, and how beaks and feet suit what a bird eats and where it lives. They also meet birds that cannot fly, like the ostrich and penguin.

subject: Science
name: Caring for Animals
about: Your child learns that every animal needs food, water, shelter and love, and how to care for pets, farm animals and street animals. They also learn about the vet, kind and unkind actions, and how to behave at a zoo.

subject: Science
name: Clothes We Wear
about: Your child learns why we wear clothes and how they change with the weather: cotton for summer, woollens for winter and raincoats for the rainy season. They also learn where cotton, wool and silk come from, the special clothes some helpers wear, and how to care for clothes.

subject: Science
name: Communication
about: Your child learns how people share messages and news: letters and the post office, telephones and video calls, email, and newspapers, radio and TV. They also compare old and new ways of communicating and learn what signs and signals tell us.

subject: Science
name: Day and Night
about: Your child learns that day and night happen because the Earth spins on its axis, so one side faces the Sun while the other side is dark. They also learn about sunrise in the east and sunset in the west, the Moon and stars, and what we and animals do by day and by night.

subject: Science
name: Festivals of India
about: Your child learns about the main festivals of India, such as Diwali, Holi, Eid and Christmas, along with harvest and national festivals. They learn how each one is celebrated and that people of all faiths share in the joy.

subject: Science
name: Food Groups
about: Your child learns the three main food groups: energy-giving, body-building and protective foods. They learn why we need water and a balanced diet, and how to pick healthy food over junk food.

subject: Science
name: Food from Plants and Animals
about: Your child learns which foods come from plants and which come from animals, and which part of a plant (root, stem, leaf, flower, fruit or seed) we eat. They also learn about milk foods and that some animals eat plants, some eat other animals and some eat both.

subject: Science
name: Human Body
about: Your child learns the five senses and their sense organs, and the main organs inside the body such as the heart, lungs, brain and stomach. They also learn simple habits to keep the body clean, healthy and safe.

subject: Science
name: Insects
about: Your child learns what makes an animal an insect: six legs, three body parts and two antennae. They meet the butterfly and its life cycle, ants, bees and ladybirds, and learn which insects help us and which can harm us.

subject: Science
name: Living and Non-Living Things
about: Your child learns how to tell living things from non-living things by checking whether they breathe, eat, grow, move on their own, feel and have young ones. They also learn that plants are living and that non-living things can be natural or man-made.

subject: Science
name: Our Environment
about: Your child learns what our environment is and how air, water and land get polluted. They learn simple ways to keep it clean and green: saving water, planting trees, separating waste and the three Rs (reduce, reuse, recycle).

subject: Science
name: Our Helpers
about: Your child learns about the community helpers around us, such as doctors, teachers, firefighters, plumbers and farmers. They learn what each helper does, the tools they use, where they work and why we should thank them.

subject: Science
name: Our Neighbourhood
about: Your child learns about the places around us, such as shops, the hospital, post office, bank, park and places of worship, and what we do at each one. They also learn road safety rules and how to be a good neighbour.

subject: Science
name: Parts of a Plant
about: Your child learns the main parts of a plant (roots, stem, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds), what each part does, and which parts we eat as food.

subject: Science
name: Plant Life
about: Your child learns how a seed grows into a plant, what plants need to stay healthy, the different kinds of plants and where they grow, and how seeds travel.

subject: Science
name: Safety Rules
about: Your child learns simple safety rules for the road, the kitchen and home, school, the beach and festivals, including whom to ask for help and which emergency numbers to call.

subject: Science
name: Seasons
about: Your child learns about summer, the rainy season and winter: how the weather changes, and the clothes, food, festivals and activities that go with each season in India and the UAE.

subject: Science
name: Sources of Light
about: Your child learns the difference between natural and man-made sources of light, why the moon does not make its own light, how shadows form and how to use light safely.

subject: Science
name: Transport
about: Your child learns how people and goods travel by land, water and air, who drives each vehicle, how transport has changed over time and how to choose the right transport for a trip.

subject: Science
name: Water and its Forms
about: Your child learns that water can be a solid, a liquid or a gas, how it melts, freezes and evaporates, where our water comes from and simple ways to save it.

subject: Science
name: Weather
about: Your child learns to describe sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy and stormy weather, read a simple weather chart, and choose what to wear and do in each kind of weather.

subject: Science
name: What Animals Eat
about: Your child learns to group animals as herbivores, carnivores or omnivores, how teeth and beaks suit the food animals eat, and how a simple food chain works.
